title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
org: Integrated Circuits and Systems Lab, WPI
note: Wearable and physiological sensing. Currently building closed-loop temperature control for a CO₂ sensor, to hold its operating point stable enough to trust the measurement.
bullets: Advancing transcutaneous blood gas sensing research toward a Spring 2027 IC tapeout at WPI's ICAS Lab.

title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant, ECE 2201 Microelectronics I
note: Office hours and labs for the course where everyone meets a MOSFET for the first time.
bullets: Facilitating course instruction and grading for ECE 2201, reinforcing analog and CMOS circuit fundamentals.

title: Electrical Engineering Intern, Group 92
note: Supported the RF transmitter team at the Lincoln Space Surveillance Complex, designing and building hardware to replace obsolete equipment on the Millstone Hill Radar — a system that has been continuously evolving since 1957, where every upgrade is just the starting point for the next one. Most of the detail is not mine to publish; happy to talk about the parts that are.
bullets: Built schematics, PCBs, and mechanical chassis for RF radar test hardware in a CUI environment.
Simulated, characterized, and troubleshot RF circuits using spectrum analyzers, scopes, and signal generators.
Selected components, developed BOMs, and validated hardware performance through bench testing.
